svg.font-family: Cambria, Calibri, Arial, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: A compass bump in the fly’s brain
the ring of neurons in the fly’s brain, with its one bump of activity
dark bar outside a ring: where the fly sees the stripe; triangle: the way the fly faces; shaded patch: the bump
schematic, after Seelig and Jayaraman (2015); bump about 82° wide
